clause: Advanced/conditional blending: Blend-If, knockout, per-channel, fill-vs-opacity [STU-RAS-041,STU-RAS-010]

scope.summary: Implement advanced/conditional blending on every layer as canonical StudioLayer fields: Blend-If sliders dropping/revealing pixels by gray or per-channel tonal ranges of this layer and the underlying composite, with split-slider feathering; knockout (shallow/deep) punching through group content; per-channel blend enablement; and interior-effects / clipped-effects / transparency-shapes-layer toggles. Include the independent Fill-opacity vs Layer-opacity fields (STU-RAS-010): fill-opacity fades pixel/fill content leaving StudioEffectStack effects at full strength; layer-opacity fades the whole layer including effects — both exposed, never collapsed.
acceptance_criteria: Blend-If (gray+per-channel, split feather), knockout shallow/deep, per-channel enable
fill-opacity and layer-opacity independent and both exposed
expected_tests: live: Blend-If split sliders drop this-layer highlights and reveal underlying pixels with feathering; knockout-deep punches through the group; per-channel blend disable proven
live: fill-opacity fades pixels while effects stay full; layer-opacity fades layer+effects — the two differ on a snapshot

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Advanced blending, Blend-If & fill vs opacity

risk_if_missed: No conditional blending; knockout/blend-if compositing and fill-vs-opacity distinction absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
